source_math_findings.independent_geometry: Positive quartic radial root and rationalized negative-reduced branch; h=2Mr/Sigma and ingoing Cartesian ell. Input restriction Q=Lambda0 makes the neutral Kerr formulas applicable. No production imports, camera regeneration or null-only Carter assumption.
source_math_findings.canonical_hamiltonian: H=1/2[-p_t^2+sum(p_i^2)-h*(-p_t+ell_i*p_i)^2] is the Kerr-Schild inverse-metric Hamiltonian. qdot^t=-p_t+h*w and qdot^i=p_i-h*w*ell_i are its analytic momentum derivatives with consistent signs.
source_math_findings.measured_norm: Initial p=g*u is formed from the exact captured binary32 q/u in80-digit Decimal and is not projected. H0 remains nonzero; recovered-u residual and 2H0-minus-independent-gkk are emitted. H/norm/E/Lz drifts are reported; exact discrete H conservation is not promised.
source_math_findings.finite_difference_rhs: Spatial pdot uses negative centered H differences in q at fixed canonical p. Absolute epsilons1e-18 and1e-22 are independent channels, not embedded acceptance thresholds. Stationarity gives exact dp_t=0. Each displacement must survive rounding and every evaluated state/geometry must be finite and have positive radial root.

source_math_findings.capture_event: The first sampled outside-to-inside buffered-radius bracket is refined by fresh partial RK4 from its fixed original bracket-start state. Its full-step endpoint matches the original step. Bisection retains numerical sign endpoints and terminates at floor*1e-28 within96iterations. It explicitly does not certify first continuous crossing or equate bracket width with trajectory error.
